Correct the headline number: six of ten readings were stale

G3 switched to the outcome-based instrument and carried six readings forward
from the saturated one it replaced -- reasoning, mathematics, unknownUnknown,
longHorizon, robustness and resourceEfficiency, all at 1.0. Every mean reported
from G3 onward averaged the two instruments together, and because the
dimensions nobody re-measures are the ones already at the ceiling, the error
ran the flattering way every time.

compareGenerations already refused to subtract a score taken on one suite from
one taken on another. The generation record then did exactly that inside a
single vector, one level down, and nobody looked.

The mean over what the outcome instrument actually measured is 0.525313. This
session reported 0.810125. The declaration committed before G6 predicted near
0.53 and landed within 0.005.

Detection is automatic from the previous generation rather than declared,
because a caller who forgets to declare it is the case that produced the
defect. A dimension re-measured to an identical value is flagged too, which
understates the mean -- the direction to be wrong in. The inflated figure stays
visible beside the honest one, and a generation whose every reading was carried
is refused outright.

That declaration also exposed a gap in the discipline. It predicted the number
accurately and still scored SYMPTOM_PERSISTED, because it committed the kind
INSTRUMENT_SATURATED while writing a prose criterion about how the mean is
computed. The committed kind decides. It was not rescored -- rescoring after
seeing the result is the thing these declarations exist to prevent -- and
declarations must now quote the rule their kind is judged by, refused at
declaration time when correcting it is free.

What does not change: the four genuinely measured dimensions, and the fact that
the instrument really did separate at G3.

416 mutations, 416 killed.

Guard against fake coverage, and let it cost the verdict

Coverage is the easiest number in this spine to inflate. Take the evidence
already scoring one dimension, cut it a different way, give the slice a second
dimension's name, and the measured count rises while nothing new is observed.
G1 did a version of this and it took two generations to notice.

So a dimension now declares the observations it is scored from, and one whose
evidence is already spoken for is refused. G5 attempted forecasting and
causality and the guard refused both: all three reality loops behind forecasting
were already scoring calibration, and all five episodes behind causality were
already scoring selfDiagnosis. The declaration committed before G5 predicted
exactly that, and the prediction held.

Coverage held at 10, so the G4->G5 episode is a persistence and the
improvement-process verdict falls from IMPROVEMENT_PROCESS_WORKING back to
META_IMPROVEMENT_NOT_ESTABLISHED. That is the point. A metric that only
ratchets up is not measuring anything.

It also exposes a real tension, recorded rather than adjusted away: G5 scores
as a persistence precisely because the guard refused to inflate the metric, so
a process that declines to inflate scores worse than one that does. Adjusting
for that would make the metric unfalsifiable.

The remaining seven dimensions are not provider-gated -- G4 refuted that -- and
they will not be fixed by another scorer. They need the system to do something
that produces an observation it does not currently produce.

Declare the G4 bottleneck response and its risk before building G5

Seven dimensions remain unmeasured, and every local score I can see for them
would be cut from evidence that is already scoring another dimension.
Forecasting would re-slice the three reality loops behind calibration; causality
would re-slice the bottleneck episodes behind selfDiagnosis. Scoring either
raises the coverage count without measuring anything new, which is what G1 did.

So the guard gets built before the attempt, and the prediction recorded here is
that the guard refuses at least one dimension I would otherwise have scored. If
it refuses all seven, that is the result: this repository does not yet generate
independent evidence for them, and the answer is to make the system do
something new rather than measure the same thing twice.

Reach G3, transfer the discipline into the founder and economic paths

G0, G1 and G2 all scored 1.0 on every measured dimension. The bottleneck
engine had already said why at G0: each corpus task was a direct read of a
value the repository computes for itself, so passing required no capability.
G1 answered by widening coverage, which kept the ceiling, and G2 concluded the
rest was the provider's fault and stopped.

Three measurements now exist that depend on how something turned out rather
than on what a file says, and none of them needs a provider: calibration from
sealed forecasts scored against procedures that ran, selfDiagnosis from whether
named symptoms resolved, crossDomain from whether a mechanism survived new
families. G3 scores 0.60, 0 and 0.33 against a spread of 1 and a mean of 0.77.
The instrument separated for the first time in four generations, which makes
the G0 diagnosis right and the G1 response the wrong fix.

G3 reads only meta-improvement episodes whose successor is not G3. Letting the
G2-to-G3 episode score G3's own selfDiagnosis dimension would have raised the
score because the generation happened.

Two comparator defects, both found by G3 rather than by review. compareGenerations
subtracted a score taken on one suite from a score taken on another and called
the difference a regression, which would have punished the change that made the
measurement honest; it now reports the deltas and refuses to classify them.
improvementTrend called the series [0, 0, -0.23] FLAT because it only checked
whether every delta shared a sign; a series that holds still and then drops is
falling. A trend spanning a suite change is now INSTRUMENT_CHANGED.

Sections 313 and 314 move the discipline where a self-reported outcome does
real damage. The command center has always named what can make money first
without a probability or anything that would settle it, which made the claim
unfalsifiable. It now carries a sealed forecast that a provider-origin receipt
decides, lopsided against clearing because no authorized contact path exists,
which is a reason rather than a guess. CRM state, invoice status, internal
ledger rows, model output and operator assertion are refused as deciders, the
same boundary the payment path already holds.

Denominator: 14 verified, 9 operating, and N12 CALIBRATION is the first
dimension ever to reach REALITY_CALIBRATED.

Section 312 required a prediction checked against a later observation, and
nothing in the repository had ever closed that loop. Section 310 required the
improvement process to be evaluated, not just the thing it improves.

and looked for "production" near each path, which is the file this session used

and the other four form two islands with no entry point. None reaches

every model-weight host is refused by network policy, and the Genome admission

NULLSTAR OMEGA spine: denominator, sealed holdouts, bottleneck engine, G0, G1

Archaeology first. The evaluation primitives already existed -- compound
intelligence evaluation, benchmark evidence ledger, cross-domain transfer,
the C21 evidence factory. What did not exist anywhere on disk was a single
generation artifact. The loop had never been run, which is exactly the
"infrastructure without a completed generation is insufficient" case.

THE DENOMINATOR (N01-N24)

States are computed from file evidence, never asserted, and the top two
rungs are unreachable from source: OPERATING needs a receipt a run
produced, REALITY_CALIBRATED needs a prediction later checked against an
observation. Writing more code cannot move a dimension past VERIFIED,
which is the difference between a system that could work and one that has.

Additive only. A compile that loses a dimension fails, checked against the
prior compile's ids -- a denominator you can shorten reports a better
number every time a hard dimension becomes inconvenient.

First compile named the minimum cut set without being told: N03
SEALED_HOLDOUTS, N04 BOTTLENECK_DISCOVERY, N10 IMPROVEMENT_VELOCITY were
the only ABSENT dimensions, and they are precisely the recursive spine.

WHAT WAS BUILT

Sealed holdouts store answers as digests salted per suite and task, so a
common answer is not matchable against a public corpus. Sealed tasks never
return plaintext, the committed manifest carries no prompts or answers,
and a sealed digest appearing in the visible corpus fails the compile
rather than being noticed later. Abstention scores apart from a wrong
answer, because collapsing them punishes calibrated refusal.

The bottleneck engine ranks by downstream unlocks per unit cost from a
declared dependency graph, so a diagnosis can be argued with by pointing
at the graph. Two hypotheses and a discriminating test are required: one
hypothesis is a guess wearing a ranking. Weak evidence is ranked but never
selected first -- a story about the system must not outrank a measured
failure of it.

Generations pin exact commit, suite and corpus. An unmeasured dimension is
null and never zero, and only dimensions measured in both generations are
compared -- counting a newly-measured dimension as a gain is the most
available way to manufacture improvement.

G0, THE BOTTLENECK, AND A REFUTED HYPOTHESIS

G0 measured 4 of 17 dimensions and scored 1.0 on all four. The engine
flagged the saturation itself: all 17 dimensions depend on evaluation, so
it carried the highest leverage in the graph. Its hypothesis was that the
tasks were too easy, each a direct read of a value an artifact states.

G1 ran the discriminating test. Nine dimensions, every answer derived
across artifacts rather than read -- and every score still 1.0.

The hypothesis is REFUTED. It is recorded in refutations.json and the
engine now refuses to re-select it, because re-running a falsified
candidate spends generations confirming what was already disproved.

The successor diagnosis is worse news and better science: every local task
is a deterministic assertion over repository artifacts, so it measures the
internal consistency the existing 6,900-test suite already enforces, not
capability. Separating them needs a judgement the repository does not
compute -- which needs a configured model provider. That is an external
gate, not a software gap, and no further corpus authorship closes it.

Denominator after the cycle: ABSENT 3 to 0, OPERATING 1 to 6, and
REALITY_CALIBRATED still 0 -- nothing here has yet predicted something and
been checked against reality. Velocity reports INSUFFICIENT_DATA because
two points are a line. Acceleration is NOT_ESTABLISHED.

Eight mutants killed across the four modules: removing a dimension,
reaching OPERATING from source alone, a sealed task returning its answer,
dropping the digest salt, accepting one hypothesis, letting weak evidence
rank first, defaulting an unmeasured dimension to zero, and calling a
trend from two points.

Also merges origin/main, which landed the Universal Context OS (#867).

253 sections read MISSING because the matcher will not split a title on
whitespace -- "GENESIS for Life" contains "GENESIS", and a looser join is
exactly how a coverage report becomes fiction. That understates coverage,
which is the safe direction but not a resting place.

So a section may now declare the repository name that actually implements

still computed from what that search finds, so an alias cannot promote a
row. One of the six declared lands on PARTIAL rather than
VERIFIED_CURRENT precisely because the module it names has no test.

An alias that stops resolving fails the compile rather than quietly
reverting its row to MISSING, and a section the repository already
answers under its own title is never redirected. Both are
mutation-verified, as is the dead-alias refusal.

Build the top cut-set gap: a per-provider model failure map

The reconciler's highest-reference genuinely-absent section was CXLIX
MODEL FAILURE MAP -- nine other sections depend on knowing what a
specific provider gets wrong, and nothing in the tree modelled it. I
checked it was absent rather than renamed before building.

The router already scores candidates on aggregate quality and
reliability. An average is the wrong shape for the failure that matters:
a model that is excellent overall and reliably fabricates citations is
not a slightly-worse model, it is the wrong model for anything
citation-bearing and a fine one everywhere else. Averaged into one
reliability number that distinction disappears and the router keeps
choosing it for the one task class it cannot do.

So failures are recorded per provider x model x failure mode, over a
closed vocabulary -- an open one lets a caller invent a mode and attach
a penalty to it, which makes the map a way to express a preference about
a provider rather than a record of what it did. A mode becomes
SYSTEMATIC only on enough distinct non-self-reported observations: two
bad answers are an anecdote, identical observation ids collapse so
replay cannot manufacture a pattern, and a model's own account of its
mistake is evidence about the account. Penalties are bounded per mode
and in total, because an unbounded penalty is a blacklist by arithmetic.

Wired into routeModel as an optional input that subtracts rather than
disqualifies, and surfaced on the receipt so a route taken despite a
known weakness says so. Absent a map, routing is byte-identical to what
it was.

Mutation-verified: letting self-report count as independent, letting
replay accumulate, removing the penalty cap, ignoring task class,
reporting an OBSERVED mode as systematic, and removing the router
subtraction each fail the suite. The fifth of those initially survived
and exposed a real gap in my own test, which is now closed.

The reconciler independently re-measures the section as VERIFIED_CURRENT
on module, test and production-reachability evidence -- it was not told.

Also finishes the main repair: eight more rotted assertions rebound to
the invariants they had stopped describing. Two were wrong in a way
worth naming -- a sandwich-ordering test was matching import lines
instead of call sites, so two of its seven probes resolved to the top of
the file and the ordering it checked could never hold; and a git-pinning
assertion demanded a weaker form than the installer now uses, which
resolves the path through realpath.

Deterministic suite: 55 failures at session start -> 1, which requires a
clean working tree and passes once this is committed.

Handoff updated: active mission, the NULLSTAR reconciliation state, and
two new blockers (alias reconciliation, and the autonomy wake having no
schedule, which is a founder spend decision).

Import PROJECT NULLSTAR and reconcile it against the organism

The founder delivered a 336-section directive in session. A session
transcript is not project memory, so it is imported per the chat-import
protocol as a durable human/machine pair with its truth class recorded:
FOUNDER_DIRECTIVE_IMPORTED / CHAT_SPEC_GOAL. Importing it records what
was asked for. It proves nothing implemented and grants no authority.

NULLSTAR is an internal codename for an execution-discipline program
beneath the existing hierarchy, not a new North Star. The Sovereign
Cognitive Continuum remains terminal; the Personal Civilization Engine
remains the contained life organism.

Section CCCVI asks for the thing this repository could not do: ingest a
new directive and say which of its requirements the organism already
satisfies. UberBond can compile coverage of its own canon, but a
directive arrives as prose under different names, and whichever model
reads it next has no way to tell a standing organ from an unmet
requirement. That is how a repository acquires a second capability
genome -- each one a sincere answer to a requirement already covered.

So the reconciler compiles a row per section and computes each state
from evidence, reusing the coverage matrix's locator and repo index
rather than growing a second view of the tree. Its discipline is the
matrix's: a name match alone never reaches VERIFIED_CURRENT, a boundary
or external gate cannot be satisfied by code, a milestone is blocked
until a receipt is supplied, a canonical concept lifts a row only as
high as that concept was independently rated, and a declaration may
excuse work but never claim it. Row count must equal section count.

It ranks unmet build targets by how often the rest of the corpus refers
to them -- a quantity read off the directive itself, recomputable and
arguable. It does not score them or estimate cost or unlock, because
sections CCCVII and CCCXIII name an underivable number as theater.

First run on this source: 25 VERIFIED_CURRENT, 29 PARTIAL, 14 BLOCKED,
14 NOT_CURRENTLY_JUSTIFIED, 254 MISSING. That MISSING count is an upper
bound and is reported as one: the matcher will not split a title on
whitespace, so a section the repository implements under a different
name reads unmet until a reviewed alias says otherwise. Understating
coverage is the safe direction and the number is honest about it.

Guards verified by mutation: allowing a source-only match to claim
VERIFIED_CURRENT, letting a boundary be satisfied by code, letting a
declaration claim completion, and dropping a section each fail the
suite.

  replacing it with a literal survived every declared suite.
- Four modules declared the canonical ZERO_EXTERNAL_EFFECTS name over a

  planning receipts contain, so it is now named once in effect-ledgers
  instead of being re-declared per module.
- Ten modules had landed with tests and no entry point or
  classification; they are recorded as NEEDS_TRIAGE with what is
  actually undecided about each.
- Five mutation anchors pointed at text that no longer exists, so five
  guards were silently untested. Re-anchored; two then survived, which
  is its own finding: CONV-07 named a suite that never asserted the SKU
  (test added), and CALIB-01 targeted one of two redundant integrity
  checks so the other absorbed it (retargeted at the verdict). All five
  now kill.

ROTTED BINDINGS (the tree was right, the assertion had stopped
describing it)

Test fixtures that had not kept up with tightened verifiers: the
state-evidence tribunal now requires VERIFIED_CURRENT rows to carry
evidence, the denominator requires an explicit concept/alias count, the
durable scheduler requires a settings store, and the first-cash
fulfilment runtime requires a bound prospect. Three Gmail adapter suites
used a fixture domain containing "uberbond", which the privacy firewall
correctly denied; the firewall is unchanged and the fixture is renamed.
Reason codes, truth-boundary wording and a schema version had drifted;
assertions now bind to the invariant rather than an inflection.

Two assertions were demanding something untrue and are replaced rather
than relaxed: the autonomy wake workflow has no cron in this source and
turning one on is a recurring spend the founder has not authorized, and
the handoff's runtime-proof blocker is genuinely closed, so requiring
its literal entry would invent a blocker.

The self-maintainer `|| true` guard now names the one place swallowing a
failure is correct -- teardown -- instead of banning the operator
outright, which is what made it fail the moment cleanup was added.

Also bounds the brain packet's mission line, which had pushed the
startup packet past its byte budget; the full text stays one documented
read away.
